name: Poinsettia
description: Cointreau, cranberry, and sparkling wine—the Christmas highball, now that cranberry is on the bar.
history: A late-20th-century holiday sparkler. Keep the Cointreau modest so it stays a wine drink, not a liqueur cocktail.
whyItWorks: Cranberry acidity and orange liqueur sit under bubbles the way they do in a Cosmo, just longer and lighter.
steps: Add Cointreau and cranberry to a chilled flute.
Top with prosecco or other dry sparkling wine.
techniqueNotes: Prosecco is marked unknown—confirm a bottle is open before you pour a round.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Orange liqueur already on the shelf.
